wraithMode.action.failed: That didn't work. Check the connection and try again.
wraithMode.action.readDone: Marked as read for the other side
wraithMode.action.readMediaDone: The sender will see that you opened it
wraithMode.action.readStoryDone: The author will see your view
wraithMode.blocked.hiddenPreview: Message from a blocked user hidden
wraithMode.blocked.toggleInfo: In groups and channels, don't show messages from people you blocked, neither in the chat nor in the chat list
wraithMode.exception.footer: A switched-on item is not hidden by wraith mode in this chat. "Read on Action" is shown while messages are kept unread.
wraithMode.exception.forcedInfo: This chat's type or folder is an exception, but wraith mode applies to this chat in full.
wraithMode.exception.info: What this chat sees although wraith mode is on.
wraithMode.exception.ownListInfo: Off: same as the general Activity Statuses. Turn on to choose separately.
wraithMode.exception.removeConfirmText: Wraith mode will apply to this chat again.
wraithMode.exception.showOnlineInfo: While this chat is open on screen
wraithMode.exception.title: Exception
wraithMode.exceptions.empty: None yet. Choose chats where you don't need wraith mode, or add a chat from the "…" menu of its profile.
wraithMode.exceptions.foldersEmpty: You have no folders. You can create them in the chat settings.
wraithMode.exceptions.foldersFooter: Wraith mode doesn't apply to chats in the chosen folders. New chats of a folder count at once. The "exclude read, muted, archived" options don't matter: a chat doesn't leave the exception when you read it.
wraithMode.exceptions.summaryForced: Wraith mode applies although its type or folder is an exception
wraithMode.exceptions.summaryNone: Wraith mode applies, except "read on action"
wraithMode.exceptions.typesFooter: The type is checked at the moment of the action, so channels and groups you join later are excepted too. A single chat can be brought back under wraith mode from the "…" menu of its profile.
wraithMode.menu.activitiesFooter: Telegram shows statuses only from someone who is online. While "online" is hidden, an allowed status shows you online for a few seconds; the first such status is not sent, it only opens that window.
wraithMode.menu.activitiesInfo: Statuses others see while "typing" is hidden
wraithMode.menu.alwaysOnlineInfo: This account stays online while the app runs, even in the background. If wraith mode hides "online", wraith mode wins.
wraithMode.menu.groupInfo: Hides what gives your presence away
wraithMode.menu.hideOnlineInfo: You stay "last seen recently" while the app is open. After you send a message, the app sets "offline" once by itself.
wraithMode.menu.hideReadReceiptsInfo: Read receipts stay on the device, including secret chats and forum topics; voice and video messages are not marked as played. On your side the chat is read as usual.
wraithMode.menu.hideStoryViewsInfo: The author doesn't see your view. On your side the story is marked as viewed and its ring goes out.
wraithMode.menu.hideTypingInfo: And other statuses: recording a voice message, sending a photo… Exceptions are in Activity Statuses.
wraithMode.menu.readLocallyConfirmText: All unread chats become read on this device only. Nobody sees it, even with wraith mode off. New messages in these chats are read as usual. Secret chats are not touched.
wraithMode.menu.readLocallyInfo: Clear all unread marks without sending anything
wraithMode.menu.readOnActionInfo: When you reply or react, that chat is honestly marked as read: only that chat and only up to that message. A delayed send reads nothing.
wraithMode.menu.readOnServerConfirmText: All unread chats, and everything you read on this device only, will be marked as read for the other side.
wraithMode.menu.readOnServerInfo: Also send what was read on the device only
wraithMode.preview.question: Are you there?
wraithMode.profile.added: Chat added to wraith mode exceptions
wraithMode.profile.forced: Wraith mode applies to this chat again
wraithMode.profile.removed: Chat removed from wraith mode exceptions
wraithMode.sendDelay.toggleInfo: Messages go out as scheduled ones; the server delivers them and you don't appear online. Not used in Saved Messages, secret chats, with bots, or for paid and self-destructing messages.
wraithMode.stories.warnText: The author will see that you viewed their stories.
wraithMode.traces.confirmCallsInfo: Ask before an outgoing call so you don't call by accident
wraithMode.traces.hidePhoneInfo: On screen only, e.g. for screenshots. Who can see your number is set in Telegram's privacy settings.
wraithMode.traces.warnBeforeStoriesInfo: If the author would see the view, ask first. No question while wraith mode hides views.
